name: Jellyfin Xtream
description: Provides access to live TV, program guide, series, and video on demand from an Xtream Codes provider.
overview: Live TV and VOD plugin for Xtream Codes

versions.changelog:
- Support for API IDs beyond int32 range
- Fixed nullable field handling (Series.LastModified, EpisodeRunTime, EpgInfo.StartLocalTime)
- Multiple audio stream support
- Configurable request timeout
- Category deduplication in config UI
- Updated to Jellyfin 10.11.8 dependencies
- Fixed compiler errors from type changes
